nativeBaseline.reference: native menu button plus custom vertical ARIA menu

library: menu/menuitem roles and managed item focus
Up/Down, Home/End, typeahead, Escape, and Tab-exit behavior
focusable aria-disabled menuitem semantics and activation suppression
trigger focus restoration after activation or Escape
consumer: provide a meaningful accessible menu name
provide command labels and application actions
own workflow, permissions, navigation, and form effects

notes: The current Menu contract is a single vertical menu opened by a menu button; submenu and menubar directional behavior is not implied.
Disabled menuitems remain focusable with aria-disabled and cannot activate, matching the adopted menu interaction model rather than native disabled-button focus behavior.
Cross-port pointer positioning/outside-dismissal mechanics are port-local and are not claimed by this accessibility mapping unless separately evidenced.
